## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

## How to verify

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.
- Routing regression guard extended: `workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart` AC1 now asserts the exact runner LABEL SET (incl. the `fa-m5-1` runner-name label) for the iOS legs; new `workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart` pins the xcbeautify/artifact/retry shape.

```bash

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

## How to verify

```bash

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.

A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

```bash

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.
- Routing regression guard extended: `workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart` AC1 now asserts the exact runner LABEL SET (incl. the `fa-m5-1` runner-name label) for the iOS legs; new `workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart` pins the xcbeautify/artifact/retry shape.

## How to verify

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart
```

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.
- Routing regression guard extended: `workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart` AC1 now asserts the exact runner LABEL SET (incl. the `fa-m5-1` runner-name label) for the iOS legs; new `workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart` pins the xcbeautify/artifact/retry shape.

## How to verify

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.
- Routing regression guard extended: `workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart` AC1 now asserts the exact runner LABEL SET (incl. the `fa-m5-1` runner-name label) for the iOS legs; new `workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart` pins the xcbeautify/artifact/retry shape.

## How to verify

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

## How to verify

```bash

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

```bash

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.
- Routing regression guard extended: `workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart` AC1 now asserts the exact runner LABEL SET (incl. the `fa-m5-1` runner-name label) for the iOS legs; new `workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart` pins the xcbeautify/artifact/retry shape.

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

```bash

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

blocks.text:
# AI Teammate — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# ROLLOUT SCOPE (this phase): the loop reacts ONLY to artifacts authored
# by the machine itself — issues opened by `ai-teammate` and PRs opened
# by `ai-teammate`. Human-created issues (even labeled/assigned to the
# agent) do NOT trigger anything yet; that gate opens in a later phase.
#
#   issue ASSIGNED to ai-teammate   → factory, leg=dev (fresh handoff)
#   issue labeled while assigned     → factory, leg derived by the guard
#   PR opened by ai-teammate         → factory, leg=review on the linked
#                                      issue (parsed from the PR body)
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual)  → leg pinned by input
#
# ALL loop logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the author filter, the PR→issue resolution, the
# per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
# Secrets (explicit mapping): SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required by the factory),
# ZAI_CODE_KEY, KIMI_REVIEW_KEY (optional provider keys).
# Vars: FA_VERSION_MACHINE || FA_VERSION || latest, DMTOOLS_VERSION,
# MAX_AUTO_REWORK_ROUNDS.

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      ((github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' &&
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · pr-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.pr) ||
       format('▶ {0} (SM) · gh-{1}', github.event.inputs.leg, github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      format('{0} · gh-{1}: {2}',
        github.event.action == 'assigned' && '⚒️ dev (assigned handoff)' || 'machine loop',
        github.event.issue.number, github.event.issue.title) }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned only — labeled REMOVED (2026-10-01): every label echo (the dev
    # leg's own status:In Development, SM backfills) spawned a queued twin run
    # behind the per-issue concurrency group (live dmd gh-317/gh-318); the
    # in-run dedupe cannot act — workflow-level concurrency holds the whole
    # run pending before any job starts. Leg dispatching is dispatch-only
    # (SM workflow_dispatch; manual rework override #544 = dispatch leg=rework).
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number to run the agent on (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string

## PR Description

Closes #1692
## What changed

Un-breaks the 5-day TestFlight dry spell (gh-1692): pins the iOS build+submit jobs to the known-good runner by name, makes the next archive failure diagnosable from the GitHub run page, and bounds the remaining single-shot git transfer in the iOS chain.

## Key decisions

- `build-ios`/`submit-ios` now run on `[self-hosted, macos-m5, fa-m5-1]` — `macos-m5` alone was a coin flip between fa-m5-1 (good 10-16) and fa-m5-2 (silent `** ARCHIVE FAILED **`, unverified signing env). Runner-name label resolves to fa-m5-1 until fa-m5-2 is fixed.
- iOS `build_app` pins `xcodebuild_formatter: "xcbeautify"` (xcpretty swallowed the archive error); the lane prints the newest `~/Library/Logs/gym/*.log` tail into the job log on failure, and a `failure()`-gated step uploads the full gym logs as the `ios-gym-logs` artifact. A brew install step guarantees the formatter binary exists.
- The depth-1 mirror clone (last single-shot origin transfer in the iOS chain — the 10-16 exit-128 killer) now retries 3× with partial-dir cleanup between attempts, in both checkout steps; the mirror update itself keeps its gh-164 bounded-retry updater.
- Routing regression guard extended: `workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart` AC1 now asserts the exact runner LABEL SET (incl. the `fa-m5-1` runner-name label) for the iOS legs; new `workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart` pins the xcbeautify/artifact/retry shape.

## How to verify

```bash
dart test test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart test/workflow_ios_archive_observability_test.dart
```
